text_block_list.text:
A certain TV program decided to feature a 
special on Tracen Academy—

As part of that, an intramural race 
wearing our racing racewear was scheduled 
to be held.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n♪ Choosing yours truly, that show 
sure has great taste!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll win by a landslide and have everyone 
broadcast just how strong Teio-sama is~âª

Tokai Teio hops up and down. Suddenly, I 
notice that the hem of her clothes is 
flipped up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're right! Hey Trainer, fix it, fix it!

As I straightened her hem and cheered her 
on, Tokai Teio narrowed her eyes with a 
dazzling smile.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It really brings back memories~ You see—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waah~! Prez won again~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times I watch the 
President run, it's always so beautiful~ 
She truly is the 'Emperor', yep, yep!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Prez really is amazing! I wanna be 
just like the Prez someday~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"To become an Umamusume who's cool just 
like in that race earlier, and steals 
everyone's gaze all for herself!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: An admirable mindset. In that case—

Symboli Rudolf reached out toward Tokai 
Teio's uniform and gently straightened her 
rolled-up hem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Strive to serve as a role model for other 
students not only in racing, but also in 
your academics and conduct.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do so, and your wish will naturally come 
to pass.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. "Standing unrivaled, beyond all 
peers"— I look forward to seeing you reach 
that pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...and that's what happened~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When Prez fixed my outfit for me, I felt 
totally straightened out and full of 
energy!
choice_data_list: Is that Teio's jinx, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When Prez fixed my outfit for me, I felt 
totally straightened out and full of 
energy!
choice_data_list: Is that Teio's jinx, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm in top form! After all, 
I got a boost of power from you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show everyone watching on TV how I 
run now that I'm an exemplary student!"
choice_data_list: If anyone can do it, it's Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm definitely gonna win, so 
watch me, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't hand it over to anyone... I'm the 
one who's gonna win!!

In peak condition, Tokai Teio blazed ahead 
right from the start, securing victory by 
a massive margin over second place.

The sight of her running across the turf 
with single-minded devotion, cutting 
through the wind, was truly the exemplary 
ideal of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so! But even when I fix it myself, 
it always looks the same as usual~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but apparently it 
has to be the Prez or the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, I'll be counting on you for 
future outfit checks, Trainer-kun♪

When I replied with that, Tokai Teio 
smiled with satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Outta the way, outta the way! Make way for 
the great Teiooooooo!!

In peak condition, Tokai Teio blazed ahead 
right from the start, securing victory by 
a massive margin over second place.

Powered up by the jinx, she seemed to 
shine even brighter than usual.
